name: liamtra/tts-excel-deps
description: PhpSpreadsheet + its dependencies for the Travellers-Flight-Api-Platform admin panel (adminpanel/). Installs straight into vendor/excel so require 'vendor/excel/autoload.php' keeps working unchanged. Was previously committed pre-built at vendor/excel on phpoffice/phpspreadsheet 1.21.0, which has known security advisories - upgraded here to a patched 1.x release.
